query: Minimum SIP of HDFC Flexi Cap Direct Plan Growth

hits.text: The HDFC Flexi Cap Direct Plan Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹100. Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year
